field_text_formatted.value: The preview goes in the Druxt store before DruxtEntity resolves, so it renders through the same components as the live page, and the token comes off the address on load. It only fetches from its own origin, its Drupal site, or origins you list, so a crafted link can't point the preview, or the editor's token, at somebody else's server.
